hypothesis: Joint source-level decoding of all frozen beat/downbeat logits with variable timing and competing tempo families/bar phases can improve events and unchanged APTA OLS projection without regressing baseline-correct windows.

decoder.name: dense-joint-renewal-v1
decoder.state: last beat row t, incoming interval d, beat-in-bar k; separate meter m
decoder.seed: t < d; every k allowed; score emission; no middle restart
decoder.transition: previous t-d, previous phase (k-1)%m, previous p in [10,75] intersect [d-2,d+2]
decoder.refinement: concave strict local maximum in quantized beat logits; delta=(left-right)/(2*(left-2*center+right)), clamp +/-1/2; in-domain neighbors only; otherwise zero

development_gates.event_metric_units: fraction [0,1]; compare to unrounded saved legacy metrics

construction_contract.interface: construct(beat_logits, downbeat_logits, total_frames, windows, known_gaps=()) -> dict
construction_contract.input_validation: Finite exact f32 values with equal channel lengths. Source 1..1440000 frames; rows 1..1501. Runner must verify saved mono/source/row geometry with apta_neural_dense.mapping. Windows carry exactly first_frame/end_frame, are contiguous and cover [0,total). Known gap ranges validated before whole-source abstention.
construction_contract.malformed_input_or_output: Raise integrity error, never substitute abstention or fallback
construction_contract.quantization: Exact rational rounding of clipped original f32, sign(x)*floor(abs(x)*1024+1/2); clamp +/-32 first; no sigmoid or raw payload mutation
construction_contract.state_index: ((t*66)+(d-10))*m+k; array(q) itemsize8 scores, bytearray parents; sequential m=3 then4
construction_contract.loop_order: t,d,k,p increasing; greater score replaces predecessor, equal retains smallest p; terminal ties lowest (t,d,k), meter tie3
construction_contract.traceback: Append (t,k,d); seed stops. Otherwise simultaneously t=t-d,d=parent_p,k=(k-1)%m. Reverse; at most1501 states; independent score replay.
construction_contract.localization: After winning row path only; strict concave beat-channel peak with two in-domain neighbors. Rational parabolic offset clipped +/-1/2 row then nearest source integer frame, half upward. No endpoint neighbor, deduplication, coordinate clamp or re-decoding.
construction_contract.ownership: Final refined frames determine original S6 membership, each once; preserve global source ordinals, downbeat same event iff phase0; record moved window ownership
construction_contract.null_and_minimum: Compare best m=3/4 score to0, then minimum9 events on winner only; do not select runner-up after abstention
construction_contract.per_meter_diagnostics: Best terminal path/score each meter and their difference; not global top2, not confidence, no margin-based abstention

runner_contract.process_isolation: Construct has no prepared/labels option; evaluator imports occur only in evaluate process. Constructor receives permitted evidence and geometry only. Do not claim OS sandbox.
runner_contract.binding: Clean current tracked source, protocol/plan hashes, completed dense report, all payload/record hashes, legacy worker/event records and relevant runtime files. Check exact100-source unique/order identity. Hashing labels/saved scores for identity is not parsing them; never pass them to construction.
runner_contract.geometry: Reproduce saved resampling/mapping/coverage; original full logit rows retained externally, exclude >=source-end centers from candidate events/refinement neighbors
runner_contract.freeze: Write all100 candidates and hashes before candidates-frozen.private.json. Recheck input/source bindings, full cohort and clean same HEAD. Evaluate as separate process only after this complete freeze.
runner_contract.measurement_source: Construct and evaluate on the same clean implementation commit, already committed/pushed with preflight; no edits during measured run
runner_contract.output_policy: Refuse existing destinations; preserve every partial/failed attempt; no overwrite or automatic real retry
runner_contract.watchdog: Parent enforces60-second construction worker and1800-second whole-process caps including binding/recheck; evaluator/verifier each1800 seconds. Measure/enforce parent and worker RSS with children explicit; no hidden child costs. Total attempt output64MiB.
runner_contract.private_output: Per-source candidates, event/projection/actual scores, paired changes, statuses, hashes and resource records outside Git
runner_contract.public_output: Aggregates, gate verdicts, evidence identities and scope only; no private IDs, source coordinates or labels

evaluation_contract.denominators: All100 sources/600 windows,401 complete/199 incomplete reference contexts. Unknown/missing support is not success.
evaluation_contract.events: Unchanged apta_1_1_neural_comparison.event_metrics: integer beat/downbeat frames divided by48000 for both candidate and legacy; original5s trim,70ms F1 and CMLt. Empty predictions score0. Reproduce all old event scores and exact unrounded macro values.
evaluation_contract.projection: Unchanged apta_1_1_neural_reference.project over candidate refined events for each original window; unchanged score_window and two-complete-equal-bars meter rule. Same candidate-derived meter; no old meter borrowing. This is OLS compatibility, not variable-grid preservation.
evaluation_contract.nominal_sequence: points_for_control(projected_window) and unchanged score_points. Reproduce old187 joint/178 complete; candidate nominal joint must agree with frozen score_window.
evaluation_contract.actual_sequence: Candidate refined source events use next consecutive global event delta, final successorNone. Original windows retain ownership, cross-window source successor allowed. Unchanged score_points. OLS actual diagnostic uses original learned-piecewise control_points/score_point_windows(actual=True) semantics, reproducing101 joint/97 complete; disclose successor availability differences.
evaluation_contract.paired: Per-window OLS nominal period/phase/joint/meter/downbeat breaks; coarse joint breaks; OLS actual period/phase/joint breaks. Retain both original coarse-to-OLS regressions. No labels select source/window/path or fallback.
evaluation_contract.event_gates: Each of4 event macros may not decrease by more than1e-12 in units[0,1] against exact legacy values, not displayed rounded percentages. Report per-source and genre changes without treating macro pass as genre/confidence qualification.
evaluation_contract.label_isolation_check: Synthetic absent/permuted labels leave construction bytes unchanged; after freeze verify candidate identity and reproduce saved outputs without fitting to labels.
evaluation_contract.run_order: One fixed complete100-source attempt in original order, aggregate musical veto after complete valid cohort. Stop immediately on integrity/resource failure.
evaluation_contract.raw_center_alternative: Only private numerical debugging; no second scored candidate selected after labels

verification_contract.synthetic_tests: Quantization/ties/extremes/nonfinite, schema/gaps, seeds/terminal, traceback,3/4+4/4 pulses, variable timing, competition, null/min9, localization, endpoints/window crossing, ordinals, source ownership, missing successors, freeze corruption and label isolation
verification_contract.independent_oracle: Enumerate all paths for <=24 rows without production recurrence/tie/traceback helpers; compare both meter optima and exact tie order before min9 wrapper. Add manually scored >=3-beat penalty fixtures.
verification_contract.independent_verifier: Separate scalar recurrence/indexing/traceback, same registered constants; generated parity before music, all100 real frozen candidate paths and score/coordinate/window replay afterwards, no new model forward
verification_contract.full_size_resources: 1501-row synthetic pulse and ambiguous/flat fixtures, state-array byte bound, worker timeout/RSS/output cap failure tests
verification_contract.regression_controls: Existing dense capture, learned-piecewise and event-representation stdlib suites; unchanged focused Rust builder/grid/native-validation/segmented-example controls debug+release, fmt, focused Clippy Werror, no-default lib check

decision_on_musical_failure: Freeze REJECTED; no transfer, retuning or native port
decision_on_integrity_failure: Preserve INVALID/INCOMPLETE attempt; no musical verdict or automatic retry
success_action: DEVELOPMENT_PASS_ONLY; commit/push result, then separately register proven-independent development transfer. Whole-pipeline P4 budget/feasibility and representation gates before substantial Rust port.
